summary: Students, a counselor and a veteran teacher speak for the programs and jobs on a cut list.
realLife: At school board hearings, a high school senior praised teachers as mentors for the whole school, a counselor whose job was cut to part time said mental health needs cannot be scheduled around a short week, a spouse spoke of a lost job and being called waste, and a teacher of twenty-five years said morale had never been so fragile.
sources: NCTV17 (Naperville, Illinois), 'Naperville District 203 votes down plan to cut teachers after community outcry', March 2026: https://www.nctv17.org/news/naperville-district-203-votes-down-plan-to-cut-teachers-after-community-outcry/
